items.title: Candido Camero — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He joined Katherine Dunham’s Afro- Cuban company.

ctx.x: Ya. Camero After the Habana Madrid, we went to Chicago. Then we returned from Chicago to La Conga.

And there you replaced another dancing couple made up of Cacha and Chano Pozo. Camero Well, they came later. We were . . . the show was made up of . . . Miguelito Valdés, he was the star of the show. So in that show we were Carmen and Rolando, I was the bongo player for them, then came Chano with Pepe and Cacha. Cacha was Chano’s wife and Pepe was Cacha’s dance partner. After there well, then we left when the contract was up. Chano went to work alone. The couple went one way and Chano another. He joined Katherine…
